lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn6S8 (reduced formula Mn3S4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows manganese centers in two environments: octahedral coordination with six sulfur neighbors, and a six-coordinate environment with mixed Mn and S neighbors. Sulfur centers are six-coordinate with Mn neighbors. Polyhedral sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between octahedral Mn polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Mn octahedra and the six-vertex Mn polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connects all 14 unit-cell sites.
